releaseNote.summary: A task binding can shape its input and write its output with declarative input/output set, into and select blocks (Dynamic Expresso, no .csx); a dynamicExpresso mapping script is now a publish error.

declarativeTaskMappings.description: Optional input and output blocks on a task binding (onExecuteTask) with select, into and set over JSON paths; values are Dynamic Expresso expressions over data, input, instance, now, user, context and (output phase) result. One instance-data append per mapping, no Roslyn compile, publish-time validation. Mutually exclusive with a mapping script on the same binding.

migrations.title: A task binding mapping with location dynamicExpresso is rejected at publish
migrations.description: A task binding's mapping ScriptCode with location dynamicExpresso is now a publish error. A single expression cannot implement both the input and the output handler, so such a mapping never worked: it passed publish and failed at run time as a Roslyn compile error. Publishing it now fails with a pointer to the declarative input and output blocks.
migrations.action: Replace the mapping with the declarative input and output blocks (select, into, set), or author the mapping as a C# script (location base64 or file). A binding cannot carry both a mapping and input/output blocks.
